differences.what: A's bell top edge dissolves into the white background: the upper silhouette blows out, so the horn has no readable outline there
B's bell rim keeps a crisp dark edge all the way round, so the flare reads as one clean shape against the sweep
A has a stray hard white specular chip and busy red caustic blobs at the throat that read as artefacts rather than material
B shows a broken, faceted pink shard and a thin sliver of geometry where the body meets the bell, an obvious modelling artefact
A shows the plinth with its corner fasteners, panel and the cast EARF letters, so the frame carries brand and context; B crops the base to a sliver and shows no type
B leaves the upper 40 percent of the frame as empty sweep and pushes the product into the bottom corner, a weak homepage crop
B's camera angle presents the mouth of the bell face-on enough to read its rounded-rectangle form and depth; A's side-on view flattens the flare into a wedge
